targets.old_statement: Owned cars need Florida registration, plates, and title, newcomers register inside 10 days, insurance and title prove the claim, and used out-of-state VINs verify except for light trailers and new rigs.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Owned cars need Florida registration, plates, and title, newcomers register inside ten days, insurance and title prove the claim, and used out-of-state VINs verify except for light trailers and new rigs.
targets.statement: An owned vehicle requires Florida registration, a license plate, and a Florida title unless held by an out-of-state lienholder; non-residents who start work or enroll children in Florida public school have ten days to register with Florida insurance and title proof, and out-of-state vehicles need vehicle identification number verification except new vehicles, new or used mobile homes, trailer-type recreational vehicles, and trailers or semitrailers under two thousand pounds.

targets.old_statement: Banned gear spans front-red and blue lamps, extra-lamp trios, sirens and bells, loud or smoking mufflers past 50 feet, and glass stickers.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Banned gear spans front-red and blue lamps, extra-lamp trios, sirens and bells, loud or smoking mufflers past fifty feet, and glass stickers.
targets.statement: Prohibited vehicle equipment includes red lights visible from ahead, blue lights, more than two spotlights, fender, cowl, fog, or other extra lights, sirens, bells, or whistles, mufflers emitting smoke or audible beyond fifty feet, and signs, posters, or stickers on windshields or windows unless required by law.
